#Region "Main"
    SET Counter TO 0
    LABEL 'Start'
    Variables.IncreaseVariable Value: Counter IncrementValue: 1
    IF %Counter% < 3 THEN
        GOTO 'Start'
    END
    GOTO 'Done'
    Display.ShowMessageBox Message: $'''this is skipped'''
    LABEL 'Done'
    Display.ShowMessageBox Message: $'''Counter reached: %Counter%'''
#EndRegion
